title: SiriusXM Channel Lineup Changes: See the New Channel Numbers Starting September 1
summary: Find the new SiriusXM channel numbers for your favorite music, sports, comedy, news, and talk channels.
body_markdown:
SiriusXM is updating its channel lineup beginning September 1, with new channel numbers for a variety of sports, entertainment, comedy, news, talk, and music channels.


[SiriusXM Channels Explore hundreds of channels on our app Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BLG26082724S084)


Among the most notable changes, Radio Andy moves from Ch. 102 to Ch. 101, while Howard 100 remains on Ch. 100 and Howard 101 leaves the lineup. Sebastian Maniscalco’s Comedy Radio moves to Ch. 102, Kevin Hart’s Laugh Out Loud Radio to Ch. 103, Conan O’Brien Radio to Ch. 104, Netflix Is A Joke Radio to Ch. 105, Comedy Roundup to Ch. 106, Comedy Central Radio to Ch. 107, Comedy Greats to Ch. 108, and Pure Comedy to Ch. 109.


Sports listeners will also find several channels at new locations, including SiriusXM FC on Ch. 188 and VSiN on Ch. 189, while[several local sports stations](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/audacy) join the satellite lineup on Chs. 94–99.


See the updated SiriusXM channel lineup below to find your favorite channel starting September 1.
